title: Realm dependency auto-upgrade: 'strspc realm dep upgrade' + scheduled bump workflow
description:
Realms that depend on another realm (e.g. dev.lizher.platform -> dev.steerspec.core) drift silently: Dependabot/Renovate cannot read realm.json, and core releases often (1.8.0 -> 1.11.0 in ~2 days). Found during the lizher CI rollout (lzhr-spec#20 was a manual bump).

Scope:
1. strspc-CLI: 'strspc realm dep upgrade [realm_id] [--to <version>] [--check]' next to realm dep add/list/remove. Resolve latest release tag of the dependency's github:// source, rewrite version+source in realm.json, run realm validate --strict, exit non-zero if the new version breaks the realm. --check only reports whether a newer version exists.
2. SteerSpec/.github: reusable workflow strspc-deps-bump.yml, scheduled, calls the command, opens/updates one conventional-commit PR (never merges).
3. Optional: 'strspc ci init' generates the caller workflow for realm repos; strspc-sync ships it as a template.

Acceptance: lzhr-spec gets an automatic PR when strspc-rules releases a new core version; breaking upgrades fail validation in the PR.
acceptance_criteria: upgrade command rewrites realm.json and validates; --check works in CI; reusable workflow opens a PR on a new core release; tests for the command
notes:
Parts 1+2 done: strspc-CLI#156 (v1.25.0), SteerSpec/.github#9 (strspc-deps-bump.yml, merged). Remaining: move v1 tag, adopt in lzhr-spec (needs STRSPC_GITHUB_TOKEN secret), optional ci init / strspc-sync template.
Option A chosen: realm dep upgrade syncs _schema/*.json from new core release (RM015); then pr job commits multiple files; then lzhr-spec schema sync PR, v1 tag, caller @v1.
CLI part of option A: strspc-CLI#200 (develop). Next: .github pr job commits multiple files; lzhr-spec schema sync; v1 tag; caller @v1.
2026-11-01: .github#20 merged (pr job commits _schema files fetched from the core tag, not artifact bytes). CLI v1.32.0 has schema sync (#200). .github now release-please: #21 (release 1.2.0) open; merging it moves v1. lzhr-spec caller pins v1.0.0 SHA 2898af7 (lacks #20) -> switch to v1.2.0 SHA after #21. Then dispatch bump on lzhr-spec for the first real PR-opening test (core 1.14.0 + schemas); then close this bead. lzhr-spec strspc-lint.yml cli-version is now 1.28.0 (was 1.23.0).
